steps.name: pray-bare-shelf
steps.transition: Wamasu shrine at noon, the player 1.45 m from the station shelf with nothing laid on it; the player starts wounded (half health and stamina); E on the shelf -> the shrine window asks for a gift, the pools stay as they were, the guardian stays asleep. Nearest unnamed watcher 36 m; the headwoman stands 3.9 m off and is no hostile; the shelf wins E at 1.45 m (reach 2.5 m).

steps.name: lay-a-gift
steps.transition: A healing draught set down on the shelf (the placing confirm's setDown) -> it lies in the world, the guardian still asleep

steps.name: pray-over-the-gift
steps.transition: E on the shelf with the gift laid -> the prayer is asked and accepted: health and stamina full, the gift taken from the world, the guardian still asleep

steps.name: take-from-the-hoard
steps.transition: The river salt on the hoard shelf taken -> the guardian wakes and joins the encounter
